Reason for Mistake: Logical Error in Age Comparison. The Planner correctly retrieved the birth dates (Ferdi Taygan: 1956, Mahesh Bhupathi: 1974) but failed to apply basic chronological logic. A person born in 1956 is older than a person born in 1974. The Planner incorrectly concluded that the later birth year (1974) meant the person was older, reversing the correct conclusion.
